def smoothstep(value):

    return value * value * (3.0 - 2.0 * value)


def blend_rgb(image, color, alpha):

    roi = np.zeros((HEIGHT, WIDTH), dtype=np.uint8)
    roi[21:50, 146:168] = 1
    red = (
        (hsv[:, :, 0] <= 20)
        & (hsv[:, :, 1] > 80)
        & (hsv[:, :, 2] > 55)
        & (source[:, :, 0].astype(np.int16) - source[:, :, 1] > 20)
    )
    mask = (red & (roi > 0)).astype(np.uint8) * 255
    mask = cv2.dilate(mask, np.ones((3, 3), np.uint8), iterations=1)
    return cv2.inpaint(source, mask, 3, cv2.INPAINT_TELEA)


def build_duck_mask(source):
    hsv = cv2.cvtColor(source, cv2.COLOR_RGB2HSV)
    roi = np.zeros((HEIGHT, WIDTH), dtype=np.uint8)
    roi[47:114, 121:190] = 1

    yellow = (
        (hsv[:, :, 0] >= 20)
        & (hsv[:, :, 0] <= 42)
        & (hsv[:, :, 1] > 75)
        & (hsv[:, :, 2] > 70)
    )
    beak = (
        (hsv[:, :, 0] >= 2)
        & (hsv[:, :, 0] < 24)
        & (hsv[:, :, 1] > 100)
        & (hsv[:, :, 2] > 65)
    )
    beak_roi = np.zeros_like(roi)
    beak_roi[67:88, 164:190] = 1

    mask = ((yellow | (beak & (beak_roi > 0))) & (roi > 0)).astype(np.uint8) * 255
    mask = cv2.morphologyEx(mask, cv2.MORPH_CLOSE, np.ones((5, 5), np.uint8))

    count, labels, stats, _ = cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats(mask)
    selected = np.zeros_like(mask)
    if count > 1:
        largest = 1 + int(np.argmax(stats[1:, cv2.CC_STAT_AREA]))
        selected[labels == largest] = 255

    contours, _ = cv2.findContours(selected, cv2.RETR_EXTERNAL, cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE)
    filled = np.zeros_like(mask)
    cv2.drawContours(filled, contours, -1, 255, thickness=cv2.FILLED)
    filled = cv2.dilate(filled, np.ones((3, 3), np.uint8), iterations=1)
    return filled

            False,
            255,

    edge *= np.clip((1.04 - distance) / 0.05, 0.0, 1.0)

        vy = 19.0 + 2.0 * (index % 4)

    source = np.asarray(Image.open(ROOT / "first_frame.png").convert("RGB"), dtype=np.uint8)

    duck_mask = build_duck_mask(source)
    frames = []
    for frame_index in range(FRAME_COUNT):

        draw_wet_duck(image, duck_mask, frame_index)
        draw_stream(image, frame_index)
        draw_splash(image, frame_index)
        frames.append(np.clip(image, 0, 255).astype(np.uint8))
    return np.stack(frames, axis=0)

    video = generate_frames()
    artifact_io.save(video, ROOT)
